description: Self-contained on purpose: this is one of the repos that never extended the shared preset, so the GitLab-to-GitHub preset swap does not apply here. The only change on the flip is the github-actions manager, which is what keeps the `uses:` SHA pins in this repo's own workflows current. gitlabci stays enabled while gitlab/*.yml is still consumed by the repos that have not flipped yet.

packageRules.description: A pin bump edits a reusable workflow, and self-ci.yml fails any PR that changes one without raising its versions/<name>.version. Renovate cannot do that itself, so this task patch-bumps the version file of each workflow the update touched. The command must also be allowlisted in the global config: self-scheduled.yml passes it as allowed_commands.
